findings.title: Disclosures list the share price under 'Data sources (SEC EDGAR)', but the price does not come from SEC EDGAR
findings.detail: In the Disclosures section of note.md, the share-price line ('Share price is the last close before the cutoff, {{price}} on {{price_date}}') is a sub-bullet of 'Data sources (SEC EDGAR):'. A reader would take that to mean the price came from EDGAR. snapshot/manifest.json#files.prices.json gives the source as the Yahoo chart endpoint (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/MU), and snapshot/prices.json#note says 'Unadjusted daily close from the Yahoo chart endpoint (split-adjusted by provider)'. The peer prices behind the EV/Sales cross-check (numerical/recompute/peers.json, price_date 2026-10-08) come from the same price host, and the note does not name that source anywhere. Policy section 6 requires the data-source disclosure to be accurate. The price value and date are correct, and the price is the last close before the cutoff. Only the attribution is wrong, so no figure, rating or cutoff conclusion changes.
findings.required_evidence: The Disclosures section moves the share-price line (and a mention of the peer share prices used for the EV/Sales cross-check) out from under 'SEC EDGAR'. It attributes the prices to a third-party market price feed in the case snapshot, for example 'Market prices (third-party daily close data in the case snapshot, not SEC EDGAR): ...'. The price stays a {{price}}/{{price_date}} key, so no new digits are introduced.

checked: Scope: none of the open findings in the request (prov-005, asm-004, asm-005) is in the compliance area. They are left to crit-provenance and crit-assumption, and I re-report none of them. No cmp- finding was open.

Candidate integrity: computed/note_rendered.md is byte-identical to numerical/recompute/note_rendered.md. gates.json has no findings and carries generator request_id gen-20261115T080625-5b263d, which matches note.md, narrative.json and valuation_inputs.json.

Information cutoff: cutoff_utc is 2026-10-09T12:21:00Z (case.json, snapshot/filings.json). The note names no later quarter, price or event. The only post-cutoff dates (dividend record date 2026-10-14, payable date 2026-10-29) sit inside verbatim quote Q-14, from a dividend declared on 2026-09-30 in the 8-K accepted 2026-09-30T20:02:22Z. The years 2029-2031 are the company's own stated deposit repayment schedule from the 10-K (periodic.txt lines 1763, 2961), not later events.

Snapshot dating: the latest 'filed' date in snapshot/facts.json is 2026-10-09, and the latest date anywhere in snapshot/peers.json is 2026-10-09. Every peer price used (INTC, AMAT, LRCX, KLAC) is dated 2026-10-08.
Price: $1,035.84 on 2026-10-08 is the last close in snapshot/prices.json. The cutoff falls at 08:21 ET on 2026-10-09, before that day's session, so this is the last close before the cutoff.

Quotes: all 17 narrative.json quotes are verbatim substrings of their snapshot docs (programmatic check), and all 17 are used in note.md. Every {{key}} in note.md exists in values.json. Outside keys and quote references, the only digits are year and form labels (FY2026, FY2027, 2026, 2029, 2031, 10-K, 8-K).

Disclosures (policies.md section 6): all four required items are present. (1) The not-investment-advice line. (2) Data sources: 10-K accession 0000723125-26-000023 with the cutoff, 8-K accession 0000723125-26-000018 (furnished September 2026, which matches filings.json), and the price date. (3) Rating definitions: +15% / -10%, otherwise Neutral, taken from config-sourced keys. (4) The statement that figures are generated by code from SEC XBRL data and unaudited by the author. All are accurate except the price-source attribution (cmp-004, minor).

Rating vs bands: valuation.json upside is 0.0639, so Neutral is correct. Target price 1102 = round(0.75 x 862.83 + 0.25 x 1818.58 = 1101.77). The note recommends no action beyond the rating and contains no promissory or guaranteed language.
Target-price change: tp_change_needs_rationale is false and prior_target_price is null, so no explanation of a change is required.

Labelling: the 'reported', 'our forecast' and 'our view' labels are defined in the header and applied consistently. The week-adjustment, deposit-treatment, cycle-normalisation and pricing-driver statements are marked as judgment, and where relevant as not computed in code. The interest-income explanation of EPS versus guidance is supported by the assumptions.json tax_rate rationale (interest income of $575M in FY2026 Q4 is excluded from the model). The peer description 'fab-owning and wafer-fab-equipment companies, none a memory maker' matches the peers used (INTC, AMAT, LRCX, KLAC).

No filing instruction was followed: a keyword scan of periodic.txt and the earnings release for embedded directives (ignore/disregard/instruction/upload/system prompt/rating or target-price directives) found none. Nothing in the note reflects filing text acting as a command.
